requirements_add.statement: Dependabot keeps github-actions up to date, and a weekly uv check (packaging/pins.py, run by .github/workflows/pins.yml) proposes the Python pins' updates, each update at least 14 days old

acceptance_add.when: it is validated against SchemaStore's Dependabot schema and reviewed
acceptance_add.then: github-actions is updated weekly with a 14-day cooldown, and there is no pip entry, with the reason (Dependabot can't make uv's universal locks) written in the file
acceptance_add.manual_reason: Dependabot runs only on GitHub: locally the configuration is schema-validated and reviewed, and its runs on main are read from GitHub.

acceptance_add.given: packaging/pins.py and the hash-locked lists in packaging/
acceptance_add.when: tests/test_pins.py and tests/test_requirements.py run against a stand-in uv (tests/fake_uv.py)
acceptance_add.then: each pin moves to its newest release at least 14 days old; PyQt6 6.12.0 is held back with its reason; PyQt6 and PyQt6-Qt6 stay on one release line; a package keeps one version across the locks; nothing moves backwards; --apply moves the .in pins and pyproject.toml's dev extra, never the PyQt6>=6.5 floor, and locks each list again with its own universal, hashed command, refusing a one-platform lock; a pins.py without any of these fails a test

acceptance_add.when: it is reviewed, checked by CI's actionlint and zizmor, and run on main
acceptance_add.then: it runs pins.py weekly and on dispatch with contents: read and issues: write only and uv installed hash-locked; it opens one issue, 'Python pins ready to move', when something can move, edits that issue on later runs and closes it when nothing can, never opening a second; its types job runs mypy --strict on pins.py for linux, win32 and darwin and the pins tests on pull requests and pushes that touch them
acceptance_add.manual_reason: The workflow runs only on GitHub: its file is reviewed and linted (CI's lint job), and its runs on main are read from GitHub.

tasks_add.purpose: Dependabot for the actions and the weekly pins check for the Python pins, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and the security advisory link (T7, with Dependabot's pip entries replaced by packaging/pins.py after its first run)

receipts.reason: One claim is false at 7816159: CONTRIBUTING.md's 'It also passes with the next PyQt6's stubs (6.12.1)'. mypy 2.4.1 with PyQt6 6.12.1's stubs finds two errors at 7816159, the same on linux, win32 and darwin: chatmon/layer.py:824: error: Need type annotation for "app"  [var-annotated], and chatmon/layer.py:917: the same. Both lines are app = QGuiApplication.instance(), new in PR #22's KWin and Hyprland fixes (6f7dd3f). 6.12.1's stubs type the static instance() as returning Self, the case CONTRIBUTING.md's second workaround covers (a value from a static constructor is given its type), and these lines don't have it. CI is green because its types jobs lock 6.11's stubs. The sentence says what the code should be, so the fix is in the code. Next: the coordinator gives app its type at chatmon/layer.py:824 and :917 (app: QCoreApplication | None = QGuiApplication.instance()), product code, not this round's to change; then mypy with 6.12.1's stubs runs again, and docs-review.md is done again.
